text:
Rent dena
kharcha hai.
*Property* lena
investment hai.
caption: Har mahine ka rent kisi aur ki EMI bharta hai. Ek din apna hissa khud ka banaiye. 🏠

title: Carpet vs Built-up vs *Super Built-up*
points: Carpet Area
Flat ke andar ki usable floor area. RERA ke under price isi pe batana zaroori hai.
Built-up Area
Carpet area + deewaron ki thickness aur balcony jaisi jagah.
Super Built-up
Built-up + common areas ka share: lobby, lift, staircase, clubhouse.
caption: Builder "1,000 sq.ft" bole to pehla sawaal: carpet ya super built-up? Fark 25–35% tak ho sakta hai. Save karein, kaam aayega. 📌

text:
Zameen ka supply
fixed hai.
*Demand* nahi.
caption: Shehar badhte hain, log badhte hain, zameen utni hi rehti hai. Isliye real estate long-term wealth ka sabse purana raasta hai. 🌆

title: RERA kya hai aur *kyun zaroori* hai?
points: Registration
Har eligible project ko MahaRERA mein register karna zaroori hai. Registration number ads pe dikhna chahiye.
Escrow
Buyers se aaye paise ka 70% alag account mein, sirf usi project ke construction ke liye.
Check karein
maharera.maharashtra.gov.in pe project details, timeline aur progress khud dekh sakte hain.
caption: Koi bhi property lene se pehle RERA number check karna mat bhooliye. Skai Reality ke projects RERA-compliant hain. ✅

text:
Don't wait to
buy real estate.
Buy real estate
and *wait.*
author: T. Harv Eker
caption: Real estate mein time aapka sabse bada partner hai. Jitna jaldi shuru, utna lamba compounding. ⏳

text:
Har badi building
ek *chhote*
investment se
shuru hoti hai.
caption: Pehli eent rakhna hi sabse mushkil kadam hai. Skai Reality ke saath shuruaat ₹50,000 se. 🧱

title: Fractional Ownership *kya hai?*
points: Milkar ownership
Ek property ko kai investors milkar own karte hain, ek SPV ke through.
Kam ticket size
Poori property kharidne ki zaroorat nahi. Chhote amount se hissa le sakte hain.
Proportional returns
Rent aur appreciation mein share aapke investment ke hisaab se.
caption: Premium real estate ab sirf crorepatiyon ke liye nahi. Fraction Your Future. 🔑

text:
Woh cheezein
kharidiye jo
*aapke liye*
kaam karein.
caption: Asset aapki jeb mein paisa daalta hai, liability nikaalti hai. Apne paise ko kaam pe lagaiye. 💼

title: FSI *kya hota hai?*
points: Formula
FSI = Total construction area ÷ Plot area
Example
1,000 sq.m plot aur FSI 2 = 2,000 sq.m tak construction allowed.
Matlab
Jitna zyada FSI, utni zyada development potential aur plot ki value.
caption: Plot ki asli value uski FSI mein chhupi hoti hai. Kal kisi plot ki baat ho to FSI zaroor poochiye. 📐

text:
Sahi waqt ka
intezaar mat
kariye. Waqt ko
*sahi investment*
dijiye.
caption: Perfect time kabhi nahi aata. Sahi research aur sahi partner ke saath aaj hi shuruaat kariye. 🚀

title: Property lene se pehle *ye check karein*
points: 7/12 ya Property Card
Zameen ka owner kaun hai aur land type kya hai.
Title Search Report
Pichle 30 saal ki ownership history clear honi chahiye.
Approved Plan + CC
Building plan aur Commencement Certificate sanctioned hain ya nahi.
RERA + Encumbrance
RERA registration, aur property pe koi loan ya case to nahi.
caption: Documents check karna boring lagta hai, par yahi aapka paisa bachata hai. Is post ko save kariye aur share kariye. 📑

text:
Paisa bachana
achha hai.
Paise ko *badhana*
zaroori hai.
caption: Savings account mein pada paisa inflation se haar jaata hai. Use kaam pe lagaiye. 📈

title: SPV *kya hota hai?*
points: Alag company
Special Purpose Vehicle: ek alag legal company jo sirf ek project ke liye banti hai.
Risk alag
Project ka paisa aur risk baaki business se separate rehta hai.
Clear ownership
Investors ka hissa documented aur transparent hota hai.
caption: Skai Reality mein har project ka apna SPV hota hai, taaki aapka investment safe aur clear rahe. 🛡️

text:
Aaj ka chhota
decision, kal ki
*badi property.*
caption: Future aaj ke faislon se banta hai. Fraction Your Future with Skai Reality. ✨
